title: Shell is not constrained to viewport height; main scroll can expand the full app shell
screenshot_evidence: Today scrolled screenshots show a document-level scrollbar and support controls near the viewport bottom while the page body continues beneath the visible window; this matches a shared body scroll container rather than an independent main scroll region.
repo_evidence: frontend/src/layouts/AppShell.tsx:22 uses min-h-screen on the shell, not h-[100dvh]/overflow-hidden.
frontend/src/layouts/AppShell.tsx:31-39 renders sidebar as md:static within the same expanding flex container.
frontend/src/layouts/AppShell.tsx:96 sets main to overflow-auto but parent height is not bounded.
frontend/src/index.css:34-43 sets body margin and #root min-height:100svh but not html/body/#root height:100% and not overflow:hidden.
why_it_matters: When page content is taller than the viewport, the app shell grows and the sidebar footer can be displaced below the viewport. Navigation and support/status controls become unreliable during normal dashboard scanning.
recommended_fix: Refactor the shell to a viewport-locked layout: html/body/#root height:100%; app shell height:100dvh and overflow:hidden; desktop sidebar h-dvh/flex-none/flex-col; main panel min-h-0/flex-col; main content flex-1 min-h-0 overflow-y-auto. Keep sidebar footer outside any scrolling nav region.
tests_validation_required: Manual desktop scroll smoke on Today/Projects/My Items

title: Sidebar footer lacks a dedicated pinned status/action zone
affected_area: Sidebar footer / future Data Quality indicator
screenshot_evidence: Sidebar footer shows Admin/Data Confidence, Settings, and disabled Chat; planned non-admin Data Quality status has no stable location beyond the existing support nav.
repo_evidence: frontend/src/layouts/AppShell.tsx:36-38 puts SupportNavigation inside mt-auto but not in a named footer/status component.
frontend/src/layouts/SupportNavigation.tsx:9-38 mixes support nav links and disabled Chat inside one support nav.
frontend/src/navigation/navigationModel.ts:19-26 defines support and disabled nav but no data-quality/status zone.
why_it_matters: Data Quality, account status, settings, admin diagnostics, and future auth/readiness controls need a stable, predictable footer area that does not scroll away or mix product links with disabled/future features.
recommended_fix: Create SidebarFooter with two subregions: StatusSummary/DataQualityIndicator and SupportActions. Remove disabled Chat from visible production nav. Admin-only diagnostics should be a support action; viewer/operator should see Data Quality with green/yellow/red status and last update on hover/focus.
tests_validation_required: RTL/nav render test ensuring no disabled Chat in production chrome
Manual hover/focus test for Data Quality tooltip
